{{Top}}
'''Shusugaunt''' was the native [[Language/Legends|language]] of the [[Shusugaunt (species)|Shusugaunt]] people of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Shusugaunt|same name]]. This language was also adopted as a second language by the [[Anx/Legends|Anx]], living on neighboring [[Gravlex Med/Legends|Gravlex Med]].
